english.title: Return to Stansted Airport London within twenty fours hours of a request to leave
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having left Stansted Airport London at the request of a constable or an airport official, re-entered the airport within the period of twenty-four hours thereafter other than as a bona fide airline passenger
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3(13) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
